in_arabic.name: Asadah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Asadah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Arabic, Asadah is derived from the word 'asad' meaning lion. The name signifies strength and courage, much like a lioness protecting her cubs. In Islamic tradition, Asadah is believed to be a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is known for her bravery and dedication to Islam.
